name: Forward Lunge
steps: Stand upright with feet hip width.
Step one foot forward, keeping some side-to-side space between the feet.
Bend both knees to lower the rear knee toward the floor.
Push through the front foot to return to standing; repeat on the other side.
cues: Keep the front knee tracking over the toes.
Lower with control and keep the pelvis level.
mistakes: Bouncing the rear knee off the floor.
breathing: Inhale as you lower; exhale as you push back.
adaptation: Stationary forward lunge adapted from walking lunge; muscle data retained.
